Release 2.1

This release adds pool stats, faster retries and removes legacy options.

Highlights

  • New Pool.Stats method
    • idle counter
    • busy counter
  • Rate limiter sets Retry-After

Example

stats := pool.Stats()
fmt.Println(stats.Idle, stats.Busy)

Escaping & entities

Use <Pool> with care: 5 * 3 = 15, a_b_c and [brackets].
Line two after a break.
